name: Boost.GIL
reason: No numeric comparison against any named baseline. README and doc/design pages (basics.adoc, conclusions.adoc) only say performance is 'similar to hand-writing' for a specific image type; the single number in the docs (15% delay for iterator_from_2d, pixel_locator.adoc) compares two GIL traversal modes, not a baseline. 2021 GSoC mailing-list threads show GIL convolution slower than OpenCV. Directional claim, no numbers against a baseline.

name: C-Turtle
listed_description: A C++11 header-only turtle graphics library acting as a CImg wrapper.
reason: No benchmark of any kind in README or repo page. Header-only port of Python turtle on top of CImg for academic use; only notes GIF saving can be slow and that saving every N frames reduces size and time, unquantified.

name: CImg
listed_description: A small, open source, C++ toolkit for image processing.
reason: No benchmark or numeric baseline comparison on github.com/GreycLab/CImg (3.8k commits, 1.7k stars, CeCILL-C/CeCILL). cimg.eu not reachable (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). WebSearch found only StackShare opinion pages (say CImg may be slower than OpenCV, no numbers) and a Brno thesis abstract comparing OpenCV, GD, GIL, ImageMagick, GraphicsMagick, CImg, Imlib2 whose full text (invenio.nusl.cz) was not reachable. No claim of being faster.

name: cmt
listed_description: C Bindings/Wrappers for Apple's METAL Graphics Framework.
reason: Thin C binding over Metal (Objective-C); README has no performance claim and no numbers. A wrapper cannot beat the API it wraps.

name: CxImage
listed_description: An image processing and conversion library to load, save, display, transform BMP, JPEG, GIF, PNG, TIFF, MNG, ICO, PCX, TGA, WMF, WBMP, JBG, J2K images.
reason: No benchmark found. SourceForge project page (zlib/libpng licence, last update 2015-08-06) only says 'simple and fast', no numbers, no baseline; it wraps libpng, libjpeg and other codecs, so no codec speed win to measure. codeproject.com article not reachable (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). WebSearch found no CxImage vs libpng/libjpeg timing.

name: DCMTK
reason: No performance claim or number in the official mirror README (911 stars, BSD-3-Clause). dicom.offis.de not reachable (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND). WebSearch for DCMTK vs GDCM/pydicom/dcm4che found only an ITK thread saying speed was about the same with DCMTK and GDCM backends and mailing-list robustness anecdotes; no benchmark showing DCMTK faster.
